title: Annotatio V §.V open: Only of Fundamental Truth understood — Hannekenius at end of Preliminary Questions
pass_a_gloss: §. V. Accordingly, only concerning Fundamental Truth understood and set forth do those remarks find a place which, toward the end of the Preliminary Questions on the Theological Declaration concerning a True Estimate of the Augsburg Confession, the above-cited Hannekenius discusses thus:
pass_b_english: §. V. So those remarks apply only where Fundamental Truth is understood and laid out.
Toward the end of the Preliminary Questions on the Theological Declaration for a true estimate of the Augsburg Confession, Hannekenius (cited above) treats the point this way:
source_text:
§. V.
Ut proinde tantum de Veritate Fundamentali intellecta ac exposita locum reperiant quae sub finem Preliminar. Quaestionum ad Declarat. Theol. de Vera August. Conf. estimatione, supra citatus Dn. Hannekenius ita disserit:
notes: §.V open; scope = Fundamental Truth; Hannekenius / Prelimin. QQ / Aug. Conf.
